messages.message: Scouting
Enable scouting system
Enables the new scouting page in the transfer market. Users can build scouting departments, hire scouts, open camps and receive player suggestions.
Maximum scouts per club
Global upper limit for scouts employed simultaneously per club. Scouting department levels may also impose their own limits.
Default scout contract length
Number of matches for which a scout is employed by default when hired. This number is reduced after each relevant matchday.
Scout hiring fee in matchdays
Number of scout fees charged immediately as a non-refundable hiring fee. Default: 3.
Default scouting department construction cost
Fallback value if no suitable level is found in the scouting_department_level table.
Default scouting department maintenance
Fallback cost per matchday if no suitable level is found in the scouting_department_level table.
Minimum wait until player suggestion
Minimum number of matches before an active scouting camp can generate a new player suggestion.
Maximum wait until player suggestion
Maximum number of matches before an active scouting camp can generate a new player suggestion. The actual value is chosen randomly between the minimum and maximum.
Validity of player suggestions
Number of matches for which a suggested player remains available. The suggestion then expires automatically.
Maximum open player suggestions per club
Once a club reaches this number of open suggestions, camps temporarily stop generating new players.
Domestic cost factor
Percentage value for scouting camps in the club’s own country. 100 means normal cost; 75 means 25 percent cheaper.
Foreign cost factor
Percentage value for scouting camps abroad. 100 means normal cost; 125 means 25 percent more expensive.
